report: Revision Kohn-Sham theory (SPEC sections 1, 7): exact derivation and checks in WolframScript
coordinates: the author's coordinates {x0, ..., x7}: x0 = the hidden direction (y = ln|sin 6Hx0|/(6H) <= 0 on every quarter); x1, x2, x3 = 3-space; x4 = time; x5, x6, x7 = the extra times; the corrected metric of 2026-10-16 (version 2), general a4(x4), b4(x4) > 0, every real z

checks.name: fixture_input
checks.detail: gammas read from Revision/algebra/gammas.json (sha256 c99277bab4793c425bc26849421995fcb5aa8b2c865c0f505686a43654933c3c)

checks.name: clifford_relation
checks.detail: {gamma^a, gamma^b} = 2 eta^ab, eta = diag(+1,+1,+1,+1,-1,-1,-1,-1) in x0..x7

checks.name: C_B_Gamma
checks.detail: C = g0 g1 g2 g3 (real symmetric, C^2 = 1), B = -i C g4 (Hermitian, B^2 = 1), Gamma = diag(-I8, I8); BC = -i g4, C g4 = i B, C B C = B

checks.name: geometry_hidden_coordinate
checks.detail: y = Log[Sin[z]^2]/(12 H) = Log[|Sin z|]/(6H), z = 6 H x0 real: dy = Cot[z] dx0 for EVERY real z with Sin z Cos z != 0 (exact zero test), Cot[z]^2 dx0^2 = dy^2, (Sin[z]^2)^(1/6) = E^(2 H y); each quarter of the period of z is y in (-Infinity, 0) (the fold Cos z = 0 is y = 0, the tip Sin z -> 0 is y -> -Infinity)

checks.name: geometry_line_element
checks.detail: the y chart reproduces the corrected metric on every quarter: e^y = f dy with f = E^(-a4) b4^(1/2) (e^y dy = e^x0 dx0, e^x0 = f Cot[z] signed), e^xi = E^a4, e^x4 = 1, e^xt = f E^(H y) = f (Sin[z]^2)^(1/12): ds^2 = E^(2 a4) dx_i^2 - dx4^2 + f^2 (dy^2 - E^(2 H y) dx_t^2)

checks.name: geometry_sqrt_det
checks.detail: det g = E^(-2 a4) b4^4 Cot[z]^2 (Sin[z]^2)^(1/2) in the author's chart (every real z): sqrt|g| = E^(-a4) b4^2 |Cot z| (Sin z^2)^(1/4); y chart: sqrt|g| = E^(-a4) b4^2 E^(3 H y) = E^(3 a4) f^4 E^(3 H y)

checks.name: spin_connection_compatibility
checks.detail: canonical spin connection (vielbein postulate), a4 = a4[x4], b4 = b4[x4]: nabla_mu gamma^nu = 0 for all 64 (mu, nu)

checks.name: spin_connection_slash
checks.detail: gamma^mu Omega_mu = (3/2) (H/f) gamma^(x0) + (b4'/b4 - a4'/2) gamma^(x4) exactly, f = E^(-a4) b4^(1/2) (= (3/2) H E^a4 b4^(-1/2) gamma^(x0) + ...: the field-theory record)

checks.name: spin_connection_time_terms
checks.detail: per direction: the hidden direction gives (1/2) h4 gamma^(x4), the 3-space (3/2) a4' gamma^(x4), the extra times (3/2) h4 gamma^(x4) + (3/2)(H/f) gamma^(x0) (h4 = b4'/(2 b4) - a4', the rate of f): (1/2) h4 + (3/2) a4' + (3/2) h4 = b4'/b4 - a4'/2; Omega_x4 = 0, Omega_y != 0 (f depends on x4)

checks.name: spin_connection_slash_x0_chart
checks.detail: in the author's chart (x0..x7), a4 = a4[x4], b4 = b4[x4]: gamma^mu Omega_mu = (3/2) H E^a4 b4^(-1/2) gamma^(x0) + (b4'/b4 - a4'/2) gamma^(x4) for every real z (exact zero test)

checks.name: ansatz_removes_spin_connection
checks.detail: gamma^mu D_mu (e^{ik.x} E^(-(3/2) H y) E^(a4/2) b4^(-1) chi(y, x4)) = e^{ik.x} E^(-(3/2) H y) E^(a4/2) b4^(-1) [(1/f) g0 d_y + g4 d_x4 + i kappa k.gamma] chi, kappa = E^(-a4) (no dependence on y), f = E^(-a4) b4^(1/2): exact for time-dependent a4 and b4

checks.name: ansatz_without_y_factor_term_survives
checks.detail: without E^(-(3/2) H y) the term (3/2)(H/f) gamma^(x0) chi survives

checks.name: ansatz_without_x4_factor_term_survives
checks.detail: without E^(a4/2) b4^(-1) the term (b4'/b4 - a4'/2) gamma^(x4) chi survives: E^(a4/2) b4^(-1) E^(-(3/2) H y) is the half-density of sqrt|g| = E^(-a4) b4^2 E^(3 H y)

checks.name: ansatz_norm
checks.detail: sqrt|g| (E^(-(3/2) H y) E^(a4/2) b4^(-1))^2 = 1 in the y chart: int sqrt|g| Psi^dag Psi over the hidden direction = int chi^dag chi dy for every a4 and b4 (the Hilbert norm of the reduced problem)

checks.name: hamiltonian_16_hermitian
checks.detail: i d_x4 chi = h chi with h = (i/f) g4 g0 d_y - kappa k_j g4 g^j + M(-i g4) + v: g4 g0 real symmetric, g4 g^j and -i g4 Hermitian

checks.name: blocks_commuting_set
checks.detail: J = g0 g1 g4, K1 = g2 g3, K2 = g5 g6 commute with each other and with g0, g0 g1, g0 g4, B, C

checks.name: blocks_basis_unitary
checks.detail: V = U/(2 Sqrt[2]) unitary, U entries in {0, +-1, +-I}; seeds (0-based) {4, 0, 0, 4, 0, 4, 4, 0}

checks.name: blocks_forms
checks.detail: block (j,s2,s3): g0 = sigma3, g0 g1 = -i sigma2, g0 g4 = j sigma1, B = j s2, C = s2 sigma2, BC = j sigma2, g4 g1 = -j sigma3, B g0 = j s2 sigma3, J = j, K1 = i s2, K2 = i s3

checks.name: blocks_relation_to_Gamma
checks.detail: Gamma anticommutes with J, commutes with K1, K2: block (j,s2,s3) <-> (-j,s2,s3) with 2x2 entry s2 sigma2

checks.name: block_hamiltonian
checks.detail: h_j = j[-(i/f) sigma1 d_y + M sigma2 + kappa k sigma3] + v in every block of type j (k along x1; kappa = E^(-a4), f = E^(-a4) b4^(1/2))

checks.name: block_ode_equivalent
checks.detail: h_j chi = eps chi <=> chi' = f N chi, N = M sigma3 - kappa k sigma2 + i j (eps - v) sigma1 (the factor f multiplies both sides)

checks.name: block_type_relation
checks.detail: h_{-1} - v = -(h_{+1} - v); sigma3 h_j(k) sigma3 = h_{-j}(-k) (also for the derivative term): chi_{-j,-k} = sigma3 chi_{j,k}

checks.name: block_Gamma_map
checks.detail: sigma2 h_j(M, k) sigma2 = h_{-j}(-M, k): the block form of Gamma maps (j, M) -> (-j, -M) at the same k, eps; it swaps the brane parities chi2(0) = 0 <-> chi1(0) = 0

checks.name: rotation_invariance
checks.detail: the spinor rotation Cos[th/2] + Sin[th/2] g1 g2 commutes with g0, g4, B, C and rotates k.gamma: spectra depend on |k|

checks.name: gas_mode_projector
checks.detail: flat good-sector modes: h_p^2 = (M^2 + p^2) 1, eps = +-E each 8-fold; G_p = (1 + h_p/E)/2

checks.name: gas_angular_average
checks.detail: explicit S^2 average of the 8-mode one-body matrix G_p B: (B + (M/E) C)/2 (linear terms vanish; only p -> -p symmetry used)

checks.name: gas_densities
checks.detail: rho = sum_occ f u u^dagger B: n = Tr(B rho), S = Tr(C rho); any p -> -p symmetric occupation (any T) gives rho = (nB + SC)/16

checks.name: exchange_uniform_gas
checks.detail: Hartree-Fock: <:S^2:> = (Tr C rho)^2 - Tr(C rho C rho); e_x = -(lambda/2) Tr(C rho C rho) = -1/32*(lam*(nn^2 + SS^2)) (exact, every temperature)

checks.name: ks_potentials
checks.detail: e_int = (15/32) lambda S^2 - (1/32) lambda n^2; M_eff = m + (15/16) lambda S; v_v = -lambda n/16

checks.name: ks_onshell_lagrangian
checks.detail: on shell <L>/sqrt|g| = M_eff S + v_v n - m S - e_int = e_int

checks.name: exchange_slab_exact_fock
checks.detail: closed-shell level (4 blocks of type +1 with D, 4 of type -1 with sigma3 D sigma3), averaged over the 48-element spinor octahedral group (End(16) carries spin 0 and 1 only, so this equals the full SO(3) average): n = 8 d0, S = 8 d2, Q = <Psi^dag B g0 Psi> = 8 d3; exact local Fock exchange -(lambda/32)(n^2 + S^2 - Q^2 - Y^2), Y = 8 d1 (y-current, 0 for eigen-orbitals)

checks.name: bc_fold_same_equation_on_both_halves
checks.detail: the fold Cos z = 0 (z = Pi/2, y = 0) joins the two halves z < Pi/2 and z > Pi/2 of a cell: z -> Pi - z keeps y = Log[|Sin z|]/(6H) and flips Cot z, so e^x0 dx0 = f Cot z dx0 = f dy on both halves; gamma^mu Omega_mu is free of x0 (and of y): the reduced equation in y is the same on both halves, so a spinor that is continuous across the fold has the same chi(y) on both halves (one first-order equation, one value at y = 0)

checks.name: bc_fold_conditions
checks.detail: on the doubled cell the boundary form at the fold is the sum of the two halves, 2 (-i j/f) phi^dag sigma1 chi(0), because the y direction points to the fold on both halves: self-adjointness needs chi(0) in a line with chi^dag sigma1 chi = 0, i.e. (1 - Q(theta)) chi(0) = 0, Q = Cos[theta] sigma3 + Sin[theta] sigma2; theta = 0: chi2(0) = 0 (even), theta = Pi: chi1(0) = 0 (odd); a general chi(0) carries a current into the fold. ASSUMED (the convention of the record, kept from 2026-10-14): both conditions are solved and filled together, each orbital normalised on one half with the weight w = 1/2

checks.name: bc_self_adjoint_boundary_term
checks.detail: phi^dag h_j chi - (h_j phi)^dag chi = d/dy[-(i j/f) phi^dag sigma1 chi]: h_j self-adjoint with current-killing ends (f > 0 constant in y)

checks.name: bc_tip_family
checks.detail: tip: (1 - Q(theta)) chi(-L) = 0, Q = Cos[theta] sigma3 + Sin[theta] sigma2, Q^2 = 1, {Q, sigma1} = 0; canonical theta = 0: chi2(-L) = 0

checks.name: bc_current_conserved_along_y
checks.detail: chi' = f N chi: chi^dag sigma1 chi is constant in y on solutions (zero for eigen-orbitals)

checks.name: bc_exact_k0_spectra
checks.detail: k = 0, constant M, v = 0, theta = 0 (chi' = f N chi): even: zero mode chi = (E^(f M y), 0) and eps = +-Sqrt[M^2 + (n Pi/(f L))^2]; odd: eps^2 = M^2 + p^2 with Tan[p f L] = -p/M (the proper hidden length is f L)

checks.name: bc_tip_asymptotics
checks.detail: N^2 = (M^2 + kappa^2 k^2 - (eps - v)^2) 1 (anticommuting Pauli terms): for constant M, v the branches are E^(+- f lambda y), lambda = Sqrt[M^2 + kappa^2 k^2 - (eps - v)^2], kappa = E^(-a4) constant: unlike the metric of 2026-10-14 (kappa = E^(-H y - a4) grew toward the tip) nothing suppresses an orbital toward the tip; the levels of the extended orbitals depend on the cut-off L like a box of proper length f L

checks.name: rescaling_identity
checks.detail: the slice problem KS(a4,0, b4,0; H, L, Delta k, v_t, lambda) is the slice a4 = 0, b4 = 1 of KS(0, 1; H/f0, f0 L, Delta k E^(-a4,0), v_t E^(-3 a4,0) b4,0^(3/2), lambda) in the proper hidden coordinate Y = f0 y (f0 = E^(-a4,0) b4,0^(1/2)): h_j = j[-(i/f0) sigma1 d_y + M sigma2 + E^(-a4,0) k sigma3] = j[-i sigma1 d_Y + M sigma2 + (k E^(-a4,0)) sigma3], E^(-3 H y) = E^(-3 (H/f0) Y), chi_Y = chi/Sqrt[f0] and the proper density factors agree; on the history b4 = E^((4/3) a4) (b4(0) = 1): f0 = E^(-a4,0/3)

checks.name: ks_coupling_volume_scaling
checks.detail: with every density = (orbital sum)/Vol: M_eff - m = (15/16) lambda S, v_v = -lambda n/16 and the interaction energy Vol e_int are invariant under (lambda, Vol) -> (c lambda, c Vol): a Kohn-Sham state depends on the coupling and the cell volume only through lambda/Vol

checks.name: history_solver_units
checks.detail: on the history b4 = b4(0) E^(beta a4) the proper density factor is P = E^(-3 H y) E^(a4,0)/(ell^3 v_t b4,0^2) = b4(0)^(-2) E^(-3 H y)/Vol_7(a4,0), Vol_7 = ell^3 v_t E^((2 beta - 1) a4,0) (beta = 4/3: E^((5/3) a4,0)); the solver uses lambda_hat = lambda b4(0)^(-2) and densities per Vol_7 (the proper densities times b4(0)^2), so lambda n_proper = lambda_hat n_solver; unlike the metric of 2026-10-14, b4(0) also enters h through f0 = b4(0)^(1/2) E^((beta/2 - 1) a4,0): the record uses b4(0) = 1 (SPEC section 1), f0 = E^(-a4,0/3)

checks.name: emt_orbital_components
checks.detail: per orbital Psi = e^{-i eps x4 + i k x1} E^(-(3/2) H y) E^(a4/2) b4^(-1) V_beta chi/sqrt(ell^3 v_t) (expectation rule, a4 = a4[x4] and b4 = b4[x4] = E^(2 q[x4]) general; the spin connection drops out of the diagonal): -K^x1_x1 = P kappa k chi^dag j sigma3 chi, K^x4_x4 = P eps |chi|^2, K^x2_x2 = K^x5_x5 = 0, -K^y_y = P[(eps - v)|chi|^2 - M chi^dag j sigma2 chi - kappa k chi^dag j sigma3 chi], K_x4y = f P (eps - v/2) chi^dag j sigma1 chi (= 0 for eigen-orbitals), P = E^(-3 H y) E^(a4) b4^(-2)/(ell^3 v_t) (per proper 7-volume), kappa = E^(-a4), f = E^(-a4) b4^(1/2); block 0: all residuals 0; block 5: all residuals 0

checks.name: emt_trace_identity
checks.detail: sum of the diagonal K = M_eff s + v_v n (on-shell trace); T^mu_nu = -<K^mu_nu> + delta^mu_nu e_int

checks.name: emt_y_conservation_orbital
checks.detail: one orbital (j = 1) in external M(y), v(y), chi' = f N chi: d/dy[(eps - v) n_c - M s_c - kappa k t_c] = -v' n_c - M' s_c (kappa is constant in y)

checks.name: emt_y_conservation_selfconsistent
checks.detail: nabla_mu T^mu_y = p0' + 3H (p0 - p_t) (p3 does not enter: 3-space has no warp along y); the force terms of the orbital identity cancel against e_int' for the self-consistent M_eff, v_v, so every self-consistent state has p0' = -3H (p0 - e_int) = -3H (p0 - p_t)

checks.name: emt_x4_component
checks.detail: nabla_mu T^mu_x4 = -d_x4 rho - 3 a4' (rho + p3) - 3 h4 (rho + p_t) - h4 (rho + p0), h4 = b4'/(2 b4) - a4' (the field-theory and a4 records)

checks.name: emt_energy_change_history
checks.detail: with sqrt|g| = E^(-a4) b4^2 E^(3 H y) and the conservation law: d_x4 (E^(-a4) b4^2 rho) = E^(-a4) b4^2 (-3 a4' p3 - 3 h4 p_t - h4 p0) (+ the y-flux, zero for eigen-orbitals); on the history a4 = A H x4, b4 = b4(0) E^(beta A H x4): dE/da4 = -3 P3 - 3 (beta/2 - 1) P_t - (beta/2 - 1) P0, P = 2 Vol_7(a4,0) int E^(3 H y) p dy, the solver check (beta = 4/3: -3 P3 + P_t + P0/3)

checks.name: adiabatic_hellmann_feynman
checks.detail: along the history (b4 = b4(0) E^(beta a4), f = b4(0)^(1/2) E^((beta/2 - 1) a4)) with frozen potentials: d_a h_j = -j kappa k sigma3 + (1 - beta/2) j (-(i/f) sigma1 d_y) (beta = 4/3: + (1/3) times the kinetic term); d eps_n/da = <n| d_a h_j |n> (Hellmann-Feynman)

checks.name: adiabatic_offdiagonal_identity
checks.detail: <n| d_a h |m> = (eps_m - eps_n) <n| d_a m> (explicit family); Q_nm = A H |<n| d_a h_KS |m>|/(eps_n - eps_m)^2 along the history a4 = A H x4, b4 = b4(0) E^(beta A H x4), a PRESCRIBED BACKGROUND (test field without back-reaction, not a solution of the a4 and b4 equations with the Kohn-Sham source)

checks.name: brane_band_slope
checks.detail: d eps/dk at k = 0 = j c with c = E^(-a4,0) exactly (first-order perturbation of the even zero mode (E^(f M y), 0): <sigma3> = 1; kappa does not depend on y), for every M, L, f; NDSolve shooting (M = 1, L = 3, WorkingPrecision 25, k = +-1e-3, +-2e-3, Richardson): 1.00000000000 (a4,0 = 0, f = 1), 0.606530659713 (a4,0 = 1/2, f = E^(-1/6) (the history); exact E^(-1/2) = 0.606530659713)

checks.name: ks_theory_json_written
checks.detail: ks-theory.json written deterministically (two exports identical, LF) and re-imported: basis, coefficients, beta = 4/3 and the label of the history a4 = A H x4, b4 = b4(0) e^{beta A H x4} as a PRESCRIBED BACKGROUND (adiabaticity.history, adiabaticity.historyStatus) round-trip
